sous_titre: Croissance projetée en pourcentage par rapport à la période 2022-2024

Volaille.texte: Global poultry, sheep meat, beef, and pig meat consumption is projected to grow by roughly 21%, 16%, 13% and 5% respectively by 2034.

Ovins.texte: Global sheep production is anticipated to reach 19 Mt cwe by 2034 an increase of 15% from the base period.

Bovins.texte: Global beef consumption is projected to reach 84 Mt cwe over the next decade.

Porc.texte: Pig meat is expected to account for about 13% of the additional meat produced globally by 2034.
